Happenings

This photo captures a special moment from my Grade 10 Moving-Up Ceremony in SY 2024 - 2025. It represents an important milestone in my junior high school journey and the hard work I put into reaching that stage. The graduation-themed gifts, flowers, and messages made the occasion even more meaningful and memorable.

It was a day filled with happiness, gratitude, and excitement for the next chapter of my education. Looking back at this moment reminds me of how far I have come and motivates me to continue working toward my goals.

This picture captures one of my proudest moments at Negros Occidental High School (NOHS) during our UN/United Nations event. I participated for our section and represented the Country of Mexico and was honored to receive the Winner Award. This achievement made me happy and proud, and it became a memorable part of my school journey.

This photo captures a simple but meaningful moment with one of my close friends. After her work, we unexpectedly found out that we both had some free time, so we decided to have lunch together. What made the moment special was that it wasn't planned, it just happened naturally.

While walking to find a place to eat, we talked nonstop about so many things. It felt like we had so much to catch up on because we really missed each other. Even though it was just a simple lunch, being able to spend time together, share stories, laugh, and enjoy each other's company made the day memorable.

Career

My journey may change, but my passion to succeed remains.

My current career path is Computer Systems Servicing (CSS), which I am continuing in Senior High School. I chose to continue this track because it is something I have been interested in since my junior high school days. At the same time, my grandparents encourage me to finish this track first because it allows me to continue my education without adding too much financial burden to my family.

Although I am currently pursuing the computer track, my dream career is to become a Medical Technologist. I have always been interested in the medical field, and I hope to pursue it in the future. For now, I want to finish my Computer Systems Servicing track, gain useful skills and experience, and then continue my studies toward Medical Technology when the opportunity comes.

I believe that every step in my education is important. Whether I continue in the field of technology or pursue Medical Technology, I want to keep learning, follow my passion, and build a career that I can be proud of.
